executing.evidence: T1 实际构建、应用启动、健康检查和 MySQL 表结构核验已完成；首次失败已记录并由追加迁移修复。

changed_surfaces.purpose: Add the official Flowable 7.0.1 IDM schema required by the starter configurator.
Add the official Flowable 7.0.1 event registry metadata schema required by the process starter.

commands.salient_output: Reactor BUILD SUCCESS; ccb-infrastructure copied 20 migration resources; ccb-workflow and ccb-boot compiled.
Initial startup stopped because ACT_ID_PROPERTY was missing; this exposed the missing IDM schema.
Flyway validated 20 migrations, applied V20, created EventRegistry/IDM/Process engines, and Tomcat started on port 8080.
Flyway latest version 20; ACT_ID table count 9; FLW table count 8.

limitations: Build used -DskipTests; existing workflow unit tests were previously verified in the T1 baseline.

local_checks.check: Spring Boot startup with real MySQL
local_checks.evidence: Application log reports V20 applied and ProcessEngine default created.
limitations: No workflow deployment or runtime scenario was executed in T1.

local_checks.evidence: http://127.0.0.1:8080/actuator/health returned HTTP 200 and status UP.
Flyway version 20; nine ACT_ID_* tables; eight FLW_* tables.
limitations: Docker query was read-only and did not validate application workflow behavior.

diff_summary: Added V19 with the official Flowable IDM schema.
Added V20 with the official Flowable event registry schema.
Kept V18 and all prior migrations unchanged.

invariants_checked.evidence: V19 and V20 were added; application validated all 20 migrations.

invariants_checked.invariant: Flowable engine schemas are available before engine startup
invariants_checked.evidence: ACT_ID_* and FLW_* table counts were confirmed in ccb_platform.

invariants_checked.invariant: Application remains tenant-ready and process engine startup is available
invariants_checked.evidence: Local profile connected to ccb_platform and started ProcessEngine default.

disturbances.event: Flowable 7.0.1 process starter auto-configured IDM and EventRegistry configurators not represented in V18.
disturbances.impact: First startup failed on ACT_ID_PROPERTY, then on FLW_CHANNEL_DEFINITION.
disturbances.response: Added append-only official-schema migrations V19 and V20 and re-ran startup.

assumptions_falsified: V18 alone was sufficient for the Flowable process starter schema.
unresolved_items: T2 must validate the business model compiler and deployment path; T1 only validates engine infrastructure startup.

executing.evidence: T2 模型、校验器、BPMN 编译器和 8 个测试的实际结果已记录。

changed_surfaces.purpose: Add the versioned workflow business model for nodes, edges, variables, form bindings, positions and action policies.
Adapt schemaVersion 1, schemaVersion 2 and legacy steps JSON into the common model.
Validate graph topology, gateway defaults, assignee sources, approval modes, variables, expressions, bindings and action policies with structured errors.
Compile the business model to Flowable BpmnModel and BPMN 2.0 XML with stable node mappings.
Add enterprise model and BPMN compiler tests while preserving the existing validator tests.

commands.salient_output: Initial new test graph exposed an invalid default-path topology; no production compiler failure was observed.

local_checks.evidence: Valid graph with condition gateway, default branch, parallel split/join, role approval, org-owner approval, percent approval, multi-instance collection and form binding accepted.
Compiled XML contains exclusiveGateway, parallelGateway and multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics; Flowable BpmnXMLConverter parsed it back successfully.
limitations: Repository deployment is intentionally deferred to T3.

local_checks.evidence: Legacy steps and schemaVersion=1 definitions are adapted and existing four validator tests remain green.

diff_summary: Added schemaVersion=2 business model and adapter.
Added structured graph and configuration validation.
Added Flowable BPMN compiler with stable node mapping.
Preserved schemaVersion=1 and legacy steps compatibility.
Excluded serviceTask and messageEvent generation by design.

invariants_checked.evidence: Legacy adapter and existing validator tests pass.

invariants_checked.invariant: Unsupported service/message nodes are not introduced
invariants_checked.evidence: Compiler test asserts XML has no serviceTask or messageEvent.

invariants_checked.invariant: BPMN node ids remain traceable to designer ids
invariants_checked.evidence: Compiler returns a mapping for every source node and parsed XML preserves mapped ids.

disturbances.event: Initial compiler test graph reused one approval node for mutually exclusive and parallel paths.
disturbances.response: Corrected the test graph to use a separate default path and reran the full module test suite.

unresolved_items: Flowable repository deployment, runtime assignee resolution and approval actions are T3.

observing.evidence: 独立复核健康接口、启动日志、Flyway 历史和 Docker MySQL 表结构：T1 通过，未发现当前偏差。

measurements.raw_evidence: Health returned HTTP 200 status UP; application log reports Flyway v20 and ProcessEngine default created; prior migrations were validated.
limitation: No published workflow definition or historical instance version was exercised in T1.

measurements.sensor: S6 runtime startup and database inventory
measurements.raw_evidence: EventRegistryEngine, IdmEngine and ProcessEngine all created; Docker MySQL reports Flyway versions 20, 19 and 18, nine ACT_ID_* tables, eight FLW_* tables and three core process tables.
limitation: No runtime task, audit timeline or administrator intervention scenario was exercised in T1.

disturbances.event: Initial application startup exposed missing Flowable IDM and event registry schema objects.
disturbances.impact: The first startup attempt failed before Tomcat was available.
disturbances.evidence: The second startup after append-only V19/V20 migrations completed successfully.

coverage_gaps: T1 does not cover business model validation, BPMN compilation, deployment, task assignment or runtime actions; those are T2 and later tasks.
The Docker sensor requires elevated read-only access in this environment.

observing.evidence: 独立重跑 Maven、读取 Surefire 报告并检查 BPMN 输出约束，T2 无当前偏差。

measurements.sensor: S2 Maven and Surefire test reports
measurements.raw_evidence: WorkflowDefinitionValidatorTest 4/4 and WorkflowModelValidatorTest 3/3 passed; legacy steps and schemaVersion=1 compatibility remained green.

measurements.sensor: S2 BpmnModelCompilerTest and Flowable XML parser
measurements.raw_evidence: BpmnModelCompilerTest 1/1 passed; generated XML was parsed by Flowable BpmnXMLConverter and returned the expected process and mapped node ids.
Test accepted user, role, organization owner, starter and multi-instance approval configurations; invalid assignee paths are covered by validator rules.

measurements.sensor: S2 graph topology and BPMN output test
measurements.raw_evidence: Condition gateway, explicit default path, parallel split/join and multi-instance loop all compile; output contains no serviceTask or messageEvent.

measurements.sensor: S2 variable, expression and form binding validator test
measurements.raw_evidence: Declared variables and form binding are accepted; unknown condition variable and missing default branch produce structured validation errors.
limitation: Runtime form payload validation is T3.

disturbances.event: The first sampling run used an invalid test-only graph and failed before compilation.
disturbances.impact: No production behavior was changed; test evidence was temporarily unavailable.
disturbances.evidence: The corrected graph passed the full repeated suite and Surefire report inspection.

coverage_gaps: No Flowable repository deployment or runtime task action was attempted in T2.
No browser designer interaction was attempted in T2.

alternatives.name: 直接暴露 Flowable BPMN 编辑
alternatives.rejected_because: 设计体验偏技术化，无法满足中文业务配置和现有平台组件风格。

components.name: WorkflowDesigner
components.responsibility: 维护中文流程图、节点属性、连线和编辑状态

components.name: WorkflowModelValidator
components.responsibility: 校验图结构、节点配置、网关条件和变量引用

components.name: BpmnModelCompiler
components.responsibility: 将业务模型转换为 BPMN 2.0 并生成节点映射

components.name: FlowableRuntimeService
components.responsibility: 封装实例、任务、网关、多实例、历史和管理员操作

components.name: WorkflowAssigneeResolver
components.responsibility: 在租户范围解析动态审批人

components.name: WorkflowAuditService
components.responsibility: 记录审批动作、状态变化、发布和异常干预

interfaces.name: 流程定义接口
interfaces.contract: 保留 definitionJson，并扩展校验、草稿、版本、发布和停用接口

interfaces.name: 流程执行接口
interfaces.contract: 统一实例、待办、动作、时间线和受权限保护的干预操作

data_flows.output: 可执行的版本化流程和可查询的审批轨迹

error_handling.behavior: 返回节点级结构化中文错误，不创建部署
实例进入 ERROR 或待配置状态，不静默跳过
error_handling.recovery: 修复组织/角色配置后由授权管理员重试

error_handling.behavior: 回滚业务状态并记录发布或运行审计
error_handling.recovery: 使用幂等键重试或进入管理员干预流程

performance: 编译和引擎推进耗时指标

decisions.decision: 采用自定义中文流程设计器 + Flowable 运行引擎
decisions.reason: 兼顾中文业务体验和企业级执行能力

decisions.decision: 首期实现核心企业级流程能力

risks.risk: 业务模型到 BPMN 的编译语义不一致
risks.impact: 流程图显示与实际执行结果不一致
risks.mitigation: 编译前校验、节点映射、部署前运行测试和版本快照

risks.risk: 旧流程直接切换造成历史任务异常
risks.impact: 既有审批实例无法继续处理
risks.mitigation: 按版本选择旧兼容路径，新流程走 Flowable，并先做数据盘点

risks.risk: 引擎数据与业务数据事务不一致
risks.impact: 监控状态与待办状态不一致
risks.mitigation: 统一事务编排、幂等动作键、补偿重试和一致性检查
